annotations.title: Check whether a site may publish now

description: Ask before publishing or scheduling an article: articles allowed today and published, whether publishing is paused and why, indexed vs kept-out articles. Start at 2 a day, +1 a week up to 6; one language version of a topic a day. Never plan around the limits.
